data.title: 楪祈 · 地铁通勤
data.description: 【楪祈 · 地铁通勤】傍晚摇晃的地下铁车厢内，换上普通高中生制服的楪祈单手握着头顶的吊环，清澈的双眸静静凝视着窗外飞速后退的隧道灯火。她往你身边轻轻靠了靠——「在人群拥挤的车厢里……只要能感觉到集的气息，就不会觉得害怕了。」
data.action: 一手握住吊环，另一手扶包带，靠近穿制服的同行者，望向隧道灯光
data.camera: medium two-shot, supporting gestures and two clothed figures visible
data.promptProse: Inori holds an overhead strap with one hand and her bag strap with the other, balancing beside Shu Ouma in his school uniform as the subway moves. Her reassuring crimson-eyed glance follows tunnel lights outside the dark window, red clips framing pink-orange hair above the white-and-blue uniform. The medium two-shot retains their separate supporting postures. Carriage lights illuminate hands and collars, while fleeting tunnel reflections streak across the window behind them.
